State EN: Both man hands grasp the rigid push bar and pull toward him. Door stays closed, hinges fixed viewer-left; his feet and both adults remain inside.
狀態: 男子雙手握固定不動的推桿向自己拉。門關著、鉸鏈固定畫面左；他的雙腳及兩人都留室內。
Acting EN: Man's pinched brow and closed lips show effort directed at the rigid bar; heroine studies his pulling direction, not his face. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子眉心輕皺、閉嘴用力，注意力朝不動的推桿。女主看他向內拉的方向，不看他的臉。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Man makes a second compact two-hand pull; the closed panel and bar stay rigid. Feet remain indoors and no one crosses the threshold.
狀態: 男子第二次雙手短促拉；關著的門片與桿仍穩固不動。雙腳留室內，無人跨門檻。
Acting EN: One brief cheek puff accompanies the second compact tug; heroine's eyes move toward the bar's free end with a very small eyebrow lift. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 第二次短促拉動配一次短暫鼓頰；女主目光移向推桿自由端，眉毛只輕抬。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Man has released the bar, hands withdrawn near chest, upright stance and one small indoor foot reposition complete. Heroine RIGHT palm approaches the moving bar near its free end.
狀態: 男子已放桿、手收胸前附近，站直且完成一次室內小調腳步。女主右掌靠近活動推桿自由端。
Acting EN: Man watches her approaching RIGHT palm, hands already withdrawn; heroine focuses on the contact point with a neutral mouth. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子雙手已收回，目光看她靠近的右掌。女主專注接觸點，嘴角中性。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Heroine RIGHT palm makes actual contact with the moving bar; outward opening has begun around the same viewer-left hinge. Both adults stay inside.
狀態: 女主右掌實際接觸活動桿，門已沿同一畫面左鉸鏈開始向外開。兩人仍在室內。
Acting EN: Heroine calmly watches the moving bar at contact; man notices the first outward movement with a small eyebrow release, no smile yet. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 女主平靜看接觸中的活動推桿；男子發現門開始向外動，眉心稍鬆，尚未笑。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Same door is open roughly 45 degrees into the courtyard; heroine RIGHT palm still follows the bar at the free end. Feet stay inside; door arc is empty.
狀態: 同一門朝庭院開約45度；女主右掌仍在自由端隨桿。雙腳留室內，門片弧線內無人。
Acting EN: Man's eyes widen slightly at the open gap, not at the heroine; her expression stays focused while hand remains on the bar. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子對著打開的空隙稍微睜大眼，目光不在女主身上；她手仍在桿上，表情專注。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Door stays at the same open angle and heroine RIGHT hand has withdrawn. Free bottom corner is beyond the threshold outside; everyone remains indoors.
狀態: 門維持同一開啟角度，女主右手已收回。自由底角在門檻外，所有人仍在室內。
Acting EN: With the door held open and hand withdrawn, man glances from the clear opening down toward his own hands, beginning to understand. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 門維持開啟、女主已收手；男子由通道低眼看自己的雙手，開始明白。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Man inspects his own empty hands. Heroine hands rest loosely at her own waist; both keep feet planted indoors. Door remains open.
狀態: 男子看自己的空手。女主雙手鬆放自己的腰前；兩人雙腳站穩室內，門仍開。
Acting EN: Man studies his own empty palms with dropped shoulders and a small embarrassed lip press; heroine holds a faint kind smile, hands at own waist. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子肩膀放鬆，看自己空掌，微抿嘴有點尷尬。女主淡淡友善微笑，雙手在自己的腰前。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Heroine joins two empty flat palms at lower sternum in one small forward bow. Door remains open; nobody crosses its panel or threshold.
狀態: 女主兩隻空手於胸骨下方平貼合掌，小幅欠身一次。門仍開，無人穿過門片或跨門檻。
Acting EN: Heroine performs the shallow small bow, eyes gently lowered; man settles his hands and expression, the open doorway remains the visual answer. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 女主小幅淺鞠躬、目光輕垂。男子雙手和表情停穩，仍開著的門就是畫面上的答案。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。
